2026_05_CIN_MIA.headline: Cincinnati’s depleted receiving corps tests Miami’s vulnerable pass rush
2026_05_CIN_MIA.paragraph1: Cincinnati needs Joe Burrow to avoid another costly late mistake, but his options could be restricted: Ja’Marr Chase remains in concussion protocol and Tee Higgins is dealing with multiple injuries. Miami has struggled to pressure quarterbacks, creating an opening for Burrow to distribute quickly to tight ends and replacement receivers. The Dolphins’ own offense has been stuck near the bottom of the league, so Malik Willis must sustain drives and exploit a Bengals defense that cannot count on its passing attack to settle the game early.
2026_05_CIN_MIA.model_rationale: Cincinnati can protect its passing game with quicker distribution against Miami’s limited pressure, while the Dolphins need longer possessions to keep Burrow from dictating the contest.
